name: Accent punctuation motif

source.description: Six inspected references give the full stop, question mark or i-dot a single accent colour and reuse that mark as a recurring character and as the seed of transitions.

technique: A punctuation mark in the accent colour becomes the piece's signature: it ends statements with conviction, travels between scenes (i-dot, decimal point, full stop) and blooms or draws the next element.
purpose: Emphasis and finality; a cheap, ownable recurring motif; a motivated source for transitions.
visual_behaviour: Neutral words end in a coloured full stop; the dot later moves, draws or expands.
mechanics: Separate span for the mark; the mark is the measured source for bloom or pen effects.

decomposition.timing: Appears with the word; holds 0.3-1 s before it acts.

parameters.name: accent
parameters.description: Style token for the mark colour

failure_modes: Reusing a specific brand's accent colour and serif with the dot reproduces that brand's identity: use the project's own style tokens
Every sentence ending in a coloured dot dilutes it

implementation.approach: wordBeats {accent: true} adds a .st-wb-dot span in --c-accent; any span can seed Studio.fx.bloom or Studio.draw.pen.

provenance.observed: Single words end with an accent-coloured full stop on contrasting fields.
One accent dot serves as the i-dot of one word, a decimal point later and the start of an underline.
Serif words end with an accent question mark or full stop.
Each one-word card ends in a full stop.
Closing words with full stops; the stop of a name is accent-coloured.

evidence.notes: STOP. card's accent dot seeds the bloom.
The paper-coloured full stop of 'Fly.' becomes the page of the next scene. Frame review 0 errors, 0 warnings (preview grade).

licensing_notes: Technique only. Several references use it inside a specific brand identity (accent colour + serif + mark); never reproduce that combination; use the project's style tokens.
